body.objective: Build the first usable Qwen3.5-9B prompt-time BPE policy over hotline search/read/answer tools, without restoring the retired recursive Controller.

direction_assessment.target: One Qwen3.5 policy selects search/read/finish and track/commit/recall/note; a small bounded dispatcher executes public hotline functions.
direction_assessment.current: Published fixed hotline at 2be2f46, fact-only/single-parent and historical generator; no BPE policy implementation.
direction_assessment.gap: Reusable tool boundary, multi-evidence packet, lightweight BPE and actual policy adapter/loop.
direction_assessment.selection_reason: Explicit user approval of the proposed plan with only the application model changed to Qwen3.5-9B; highest upstream gap, score 9.

allowed_files: src/midprojectrag/hotline.py (additive extraction seams only; historical behavior preserved)
prohibited_actions: Changing requirements/specifications/TODO or this accepted directive without a QUESTION
Adding a new receipt authority or recursive graph validation framework
Editing orchestration/execution_contracts.py or shared retrieval algorithms
Changing historical fixed-control behavior or evaluation assets
Modifying other worktrees, shared VM services, model servers, credentials or model caches
Running real models, downloading weights, installing packages or starting SFT/GRPO in this model-free implementation batch
Transmitting private corpus, questions, answers or source text to external providers
Silently substituting application or collaboration models
Committing, pushing, spawning another relay, or updating main-owned state.json

acceptance_criteria: New profile uses canonical Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B for policy and answer, not Qwen3-8B, Qwen3.8-27B or Qwen3.5-9B-Base; real model/tokenizer identity is required before real inference.
Policy selects a single JSON action from actual observations; do not hard-code the dense/lexical/fusion sequence as policy decisions.
Public search performs dense+lexical+RRF once; read returns known scoped evidence windows; final composition supports S1..Sn and correct text locators.
BPE is lightweight episode state. commit does not create semantic truth or permission; note remains quarantined and Experience stays fixed within an episode.
Observe different next actions for different synthetic tool observations and a comparison that revisits only the missing document field.
Hard scope never widens, empty explicit scope never becomes all, unknown IDs/read-before-search are rejected, explicit history remains input and gold fields are rejected.
Call trace through a complete synthetic public-tool episode observes zero retired Controller execution/decision/history-reader calls.

Use actual-template token counting through an injected backend; full messages/tools count against 4096 policy and 8192 answer windows with output reserves. No fake count or silent whole-document loss.

Policy attempts <=12, search dispatches <=4, read dispatches <=4, invalid actions <=2, final generation attempts <=1, total worker <=120-second nominal budget. Error and duplicate behavior matches contract.
No automatic model retry, global PASS cache, background task or fake live/semantic/training PASS. Return a fixed candidate and actual test evidence for fresh review.
required_tests: New state/tool/policy/runner tests: happy path, state-dependent decisions, missing-field comparison, explicit follow-up, abstention/clarification, scope and gold rejection.

Strict JSON duplicate/unknown-key/type/NaN validation; known evidence and locator checks; real tokenizer-count adapter contract with a deterministic test double; context overflow and omitted evidence feedback.
Episode isolation, reviewed Experience immutability, note quarantine, duplicate search/read reuse without cached-error-as-empty behavior.
Deadline before/after calls, exhausted budget, invalid action limit, policy-vs-answer usage accounting, exactly one final-generation attempt, complete synthetic CLI and no Controller calls.

Existing tests.test_controller_quick_qa and tests.test_hotline_runtime; inspect/select relevant existing runtime/retrieval/fusion/scope/public-parent regression rather than inventing module names or counts.
Syntax/import/CLI smoke and scoped git diff check. No network/model download in tests; no claim of full-release or live-quality completion.
constraints: Work only in the confirmed MidProjectRAG-hotline worktree on feat/hotline-runtime; preserve concurrent changes.
Application model change does not change collaboration roles: requested Coder gpt-5.6-sol with ultra; fresh Critic gpt-6-astra.
Use the existing project Python 3.12 interpreter with PYTHONPATH=src and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; do not upgrade the shared runtime.
Implement small slices sequentially under this one delivery batch. If a public API mismatch or unavailable backend blocks a concrete action, return a QUESTION with code evidence and options.
The local Qwen3.5 MLX derivative mentioned in the contract is a separately pinned candidate, not proof that it is loaded in this worktree.
Read local one-go/batch-sequential-runner/test-runner skills as appropriate. Main coordinates logs, flow report and integration only after valid review.
This directive is PREPARED_NOT_DISPATCHED while the Codex version blocks the requested Coder. Do not mark work started from file creation alone.
